//: Film app + What-if scripts. Put this in your app folder, or in a folder above both the app and the scripts, then: npm install && npx playwright install chromium (on a fresh Linux machine: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium). Also needs ffmpeg and Python with Pillow and numpy. Run the scripts as bash x.sh, node x.mjs, python3 x.py, or chmod +x them first.
name: what-if-films
